title: Enterprise risk mapping & pricing trigger for 'Attestation Lite' product
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Goal: Define a lightweight, standardized 'Attestation Lite' product that bundles a focused set of SIG/CAIQ responses and a short-form customer attestation to reduce friction for mid-market enterprise contracts. This ticket scopes the risk-mapping rubric we use to decide which customers are eligible for Attestation Lite and establishes a pricing trigger tied to contract value and questionnaire depth.

Why: Sales and Legal report long cycles for customers who need only a small subset of evidence. We can reduce time-to-sign and contraction overhead by packaging a predictable, lower-cost attestation offering. This also creates a new pricing anchor for deals that fall below full enterprise provisioning.

Key artifacts: PRD (Confluence): https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PM/pages/Attestation+Lite+PRD, Decision doc (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/attestation-lite, Prototype pricing matrix (Sheets): https://sheets.redwood.co/pricing/attestation-lite
acceptance_criteria: 1) Risk rubric documented with at least 5 mapped controls and example customer profiles. 2) Pricing trigger defined (contract ARR thresholds + questionnaire complexity) with simulated revenue/ops impact. 3) Standard answer pack (<=25 SIG/CAIQ responses) created and reviewed by Security. 4) Legal approves contract language appendix template. 5) Sales enablement one-pager and handoff checklist published.
notes: 2026-02-28: Kickoff meeting with Sales, Legal, Security. Agreed to target mid-market customers (ARR < $250k) and simple questionnaire flows.
2026-03-03: Security requested control-level mapping rather than scope-by-template to improve repeatability for audits.
2026-03-06: Modeling work started to estimate cost savings of standardized answers vs full review (ENG to provide ops cost per review).
2026-03-10: Draft pricing matrix v0.1 created in Sheets; includes three tiers: Lite (25 answers), Plus (50 answers), Full (custom).
2026-03-12: Legal shared redline for Attestation Appendix; feedback incorporated and sent back for final review.
